gloss: to go up; to amount to; to come up (as a topic)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {上|のぼ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to go up, to rise, to ascend
definitions.explanation: For something to move upward or for a person to go to a higher place. Used more broadly than {登|のぼ}る (which focuses on climbing) — includes going upstream, traveling to the capital, or the sun rising.

definitions.gloss: to amount to, to reach, to total
definitions.explanation: For a number, amount, or quantity to reach a specified level. Often used with large numbers to emphasize the scale.

definitions.gloss: to come up (as a topic), to be raised, to be mentioned
definitions.explanation: For a topic, issue, or name to be brought up in discussion or conversation.

examples.japanese: {坂|さか}を{上|のぼ}ると{神社|じんじゃ}が{見|み}えてきた。
examples.english: When we went up the slope, a shrine came into view.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}を{上|のぼ}って{上流|じょうりゅう}の{村|むら}まで{行|い}った。
examples.english: We went upstream to the village at the upper reaches of the river.

examples.japanese: {被害額|ひがいがく}は{数億円|すうおくえん}に{上|のぼ}る。
examples.english: The damage amounts to several hundred million yen.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}は{千人|せんにん}に{上|のぼ}った。
examples.english: The number of participants reached one thousand.

examples.japanese: {死者|ししゃ}の{数|かず}は{百人|ひゃくにん}{以上|いじょう}に{上|のぼ}ると{報告|ほうこく}されている。
examples.english: It has been reported that the death toll has risen to over one hundred.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{話題|わだい}に{上|のぼ}った。
examples.english: It came up as a topic in the meeting.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{名前|なまえ}が{候補|こうほ}に{上|のぼ}っている。
examples.english: His name has come up as a candidate.

examples.japanese: {毎回|まいかい}の{会議|かいぎ}で{予算|よさん}の{問題|もんだい}が{議題|ぎだい}に{上|のぼ}るが、なかなか{結論|けつろん}が{出|で}ない。
examples.english: The budget issue comes up on the agenda at every meeting, but no conclusion is ever reached.

notes:
One of three common verbs read のぼる, each written with different kanji: {上|のぼ}る (general upward movement, amounts, topics), {登|のぼ}る (climbing mountains or heights), and {昇|のぼ}る (rising of celestial bodies, promotion). In practice, {上|のぼ}る is the most versatile and can substitute for the others in many cases.

USAGE:
For sense 2 (amounting to), the pattern is 〜に{上|のぼ}る. For sense 3 (coming up as a topic), common patterns include {話題|わだい}に{上|のぼ}る, {議題|ぎだい}に{上|のぼ}る, and {候補|こうほ}に{上|のぼ}る.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {坂|さか}を{上|のぼ}る: to go up a slope
- {階段|かいだん}を{上|のぼ}る: to go up stairs
- 〜に{上|のぼ}る: to amount to, to reach (a number)
- {話題|わだい}に{上|のぼ}る: to come up as a topic
- {食卓|しょくたく}に{上|のぼ}る: to appear on the dining table

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {登|のぼ}る: to climb — specifically for climbing mountains, hills, or heights
- {昇|のぼ}る: to rise — for celestial bodies rising or career advancement
- {上|あ}がる: to go up, to rise — intransitive; overlaps with some uses but has additional meanings like entering a house
